paper_title: PM-KVQ Progressive Mixed-precision KV Cache Quantization for Long-CoT   LLMs
caption: : DeepSeek-R1-Distill-QwQ-32B
model_annotation: The chart illustrates per-block “Sensitivity” values across a sequence of model blocks, with bars colored by precision setting (blue for “4-Fbit” and green for “2-Fbit”) as indicated by the legend in the upper-left. The horizontal axis contains the categories as block positions labeled “Block Index,” shown in increasing order from 0 to 63 with tick labels at 0, 15, 31, 47, and 63. The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Sensitivity” and is displayed on a logarithmic scale, with major tick labels at approximately \(10^{-5}\) and \(10^{-4}\) (and corresponding dashed horizontal gridlines), spanning values from a few \(\times 10^{-6}\) up to a few \(\times 10^{-4}\). Each bar represents the sensitivity for a given block index; most blocks are shown as green (2-Fbit) bars through the earlier and mid indices, with intermittent blue (4-Fbit) bars appearing around the low 30s and mid 40s, and then many consecutive blue bars in the later indices (roughly the high 40s through 63), plus one isolated green bar within that late region. Visually, the smallest bars occur in the early indices (around block indices near 4–7), reaching down to roughly \(2\text{–}4\times 10^{-6}\), while many mid-range bars sit around the \(10^{-5}\) to several \(\times 10^{-5}\) range; the tallest bars appear near the end (around indices 60–63), extending above the \(10^{-4}\) line to roughly \(2\text{–}3\times 10^{-4}\). The bars are not sorted by height; they follow the block index order, and there are no additional annotations or special visual emphasis beyond the two-color encoding and the legend.
